visual_action: A montage of shots showing Vice President Kamala Harris on stage at a large nighttime rally or event. She is seen smiling, waving, and speaking at a podium. These shots are intercut with views of a large, enthusiastic crowd of supporters who are cheering, holding up their phones as lights, and waving signs. One sign reads "FREEDOM FREEDOM FREEDOM" and another reads "KAMALA".

cast.name: Kamala Harris

cast.name: Democratic Party

audio_music: The video is set to the song 'Sailor Song' by Gigi Perez. It's an uplifting, indie-pop style track with female vocals that plays throughout, creating an inspirational and hopeful mood for the political montage.

intended_effect: To energize and mobilize viewers to vote for Democrats by associating Kamala Harris with positive, aspirational values.
